data_fields.name: minimap_px_per_cell
data_fields.donor_constant: whole pixels per cell that fit the panel, rounded up in donor, minimum 1

data_fields.name: cell_priority_order
data_fields.donor_constant: city, unit, border, relief, background, unknown (first match wins)

data_fields.name: fog_overlay_enabled
data_fields.donor_constant: flag; fog sprite drawn on known but unseen cells

best_idea: A minimap is a backing store of one colour per cell, repainted only for cells that changed and redrawn only when dirty, with one fixed priority list for what a cell shows (own, allied, enemy, then terrain).
decision_why: Keep the cell priority list, the per-cell update with one dirty flush and the view-rectangle overlay; fix the scale to round down so the map never overflows its panel; write it fresh because the donor is GPL.
acceptance: At 375 wide a 40-cell zone map fits its panel at a whole-pixel scale; an enemy on a cell shows the enemy colour over terrain; a changed cell shows in the next frame and the view rectangle moves with the visible ground.
